ScopeThis standard (Part 2/ Sec 14) prescribes the method for determination of adherence of vitreous enamelware.2. Referenced DocumentsThe following standards contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
